title: Note head, clause accent
summary: A reading page's head: the approved title at 72px (three lines; the accent is the subtitle clause (two lines, one .ac-accent)) → the 48×2 rule → one plain meta line (All three layers · June 2026 · 3 min). No kicker, no byline (Q6), no facts box, no plate; the standfirst now opens the paper note.
story: The note's title and the three facts a reader wants (what it is about, when, how long) in one line; everything else is the note.
